RecipeDef.label: refine biomass
RecipeDef.description: Consume 40 raw biomass from adjacent hoppers and 1 neutroamine to produce exactly 10 refined biomass on success. Failure loses all ingredients. Requires Intellectual 5, Crafting 3, Medicine 2. Weighted skill (60% Intellectual, 25% Crafting, 15% Medicine), clamped to 5–20, linearly reduces preparation from 90 to 30 minutes and operator failure from 30% to 0%. Indoor dirt adds up to 15 percentage points at cleanliness -2; sterile rooms give no bonus. Outdoor or unroofed exposure instead adds 10 points. Risk is captured at batch start and rolled once at completion. Automated processing defaults to 36 hours, reduced by 5% per available gene processor to a minimum of 18 hours. Power loss pauses processing and spoils a batch after two continuous hours. Do X times counts batches started; Do until X targets stored output.
